headline: EPS surges on strong growth
summary_short: Otsuka Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥222.76, up 33.0% y/y and 19.6% q/q.
summary_long: EPS of ¥222.76 rose 33.0% year-over-year from ¥167.55 and 19.6% sequentially from ¥186.31 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
